# Feedback Triage

Use this skill for `SGM-FBK-001`.

## Scope

- Classify feedback by actionability, evidence, project fit, and risk.
- Keep direct adoption separate from open questions.
- Preserve unresolved tradeoffs as decisions instead of silently rewriting rules.

## Required Output

Every report must include `report_id`, `module_id`, `mode`, `rule_pack`, `source_refs`, `target_refs`, `verdict`, and `findings`.
